lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade or follow momentum into liquidity voids without confirming structural breaks, leading to repeated stop-outs on mean reversion attempts. The reliance on oversold RSI and EMA failures in a strong trend is ignoring the Wyckoffian 'Spring' or 'Upthrust' mechanics required to validate a reversal.
adjustment: Mandate a confirmed 15m Market Structure Shift (MSS) following a sweep of liquidity before entering any position, rather than relying on EMA rejection or RSI levels.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based overbought/oversold signals significantly less on DOTUSDT; prioritize SMC liquidity sweeps.
